parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB cluster.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go

- **Prepaid**: subscription

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

- **Year**

- **Month**

> This parameter is required when you set **PayType** to **Prepaid**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

- If you set **Period** to **Year**, the value of **UsedTime** can be 1, 2, or 3.

- If you set **Period** to **Month**, the value of **UsedTime** can be an integer from 1 to 9.

> This parameter is required when you set **PayType** to **Prepaid**.
